title: Ain Jalut: The Slave Soldiers Who Stopped the Mongols
summary: Tells how, on the third of September, twelve sixty, at the spring of Ain Jalut in Galilee, the Mamluk army of Sultan Qutuz and Baybars, made up of men once sold as slaves, defeated the Mongol force under Kitbuqa. Hulagu had just withdrawn most of his army after the death of the Great Khan Möngke. The episode runs from the sack of Baghdad and the Mongol envoys beheaded in Cairo to the feigned retreat that lured the Mongols into a trap and Kitbuqa's death. It ends with Qutuz murdered by Baybars on the road home, and with the halt of the Mongol advance into Egypt and North Africa.
